root_cause_analysis: Meta API returned OAuthException Code 4 (subcode 2207051): Application request limit reached and automated activity is blocked by platform security restrictions.
actionable_instructions: Check Meta Business Suite and Instagram App Dashboard for active account restrictions or action blocks.
Pause automated publishing pipeline for at least 24 hours to clear application request limits.
Submit a appeal/review request in Meta Business Manager if the action block persists after cooldown.
